source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color winter landscape with misty distant peaks, monumental stratified cliffs, rocky terraces, bare trees, pines, bamboo-like groves, and small buildings and figures in the lower foreground. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motifs.

motifs.name: distant_mist_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain silhouettes in the upper left and center: two narrow triangular peaks at left and a taller rounded central peak emerging through horizontal mist washes. Exclude nearby calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: horizontal mist bands crossing the peaks
faint base transitions fading into empty space

motifs.name: towering_stratified_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side cliff mass with overhanging ledges, blocky vertical rock faces, and layered dark ink texture. Keep the cliff separate from the lower tree groves and exclude any red seals at the edge.
must_preserve: pale reserve areas on sheer rock planes
vertical ink streaks on cliff faces

motifs.name: central_pale_rock_chute
motifs.description: Isolate the pale vertical rock chute or cliff fall descending from the central mountain, including the narrow shaded crevice at its upper left and the broad tapering wash down to the midground basin.
motifs.role: central cliff face and vertical descent
must_preserve: dark crevice brushwork near the top
small ink accents at the base

motifs.name: left_pine_rock_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left rocky terrace with clustered pines growing from the ledge. Include the layered ledge, upright trunks, fine pine needles, and the darker underside of the rock shelf.
must_preserve: dark dry-brush shadows under the ledge
small grasses and shrub dots along the slope

motifs.name: central_winter_tree_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the large network of bare winter branches spreading across the lower middle, rooted near the center and sweeping horizontally through the composition. Exclude buildings behind it except where obscured by branches.
must_preserve: thin twig clusters at branch tips
varied ink pressure from trunk to twig
overlapping branch rhythm across the empty background

motifs.name: right_bamboo_willow_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall grove on the right side with vertical bamboo- or willow-like trunks, sparse winter branches, and reed-like shoots rising around the lower right hillside. Exclude the house forms behind it as much as possible.
motifs.role: right foreground grove and screen of trees
must_preserve: dark grass and reed accents at the base

motifs.name: hidden_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the partially hidden village or pavilion group in the lower right: rectilinear walls, layered roofs, small windows, and a narrow path or fence elements glimpsed through winter branches.
must_preserve: horizontal eaves and vertical wall lines
light ochre color accents on roof edges

motifs.name: wayside_traveler_hut_and_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left wayside scene with a small robed traveler near a fence, a thatched hut roof, clustered boulders, and the sloping rocky path leading inward. Keep it distinct from the central large tree mass.
must_preserve: tiny standing figure in warm robe
thin fence posts and rail marks
curving pale path with scattered pebble strokes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
